import json
from datetime import timedelta
from django.utils import timezone
from django.db.models import Count
from apps.catalog.models import Offer,OfferCandidate,OfferObservation,OfferFamilyPlacement,ProductFamily
from apps.catalog.services.public_eligibility import public_eligibility_q
from apps.catalog.services.weekly_discovery import WEEKLY_FAMILY_SLUGS
now=timezone.now()
offers=list(Offer.objects.filter(public_eligibility_q()).distinct())
ids=[o.id for o in offers]
observations=list(OfferObservation.objects.filter(offer_id__in=ids).order_by("offer_id","-observed_at","-id").only("id","offer_id","observed_at","price","currency","delivery_days","search_delivery_days","availability"))
last={}
latest_price={}
ever_numeric=set()
for o in observations:
    if o.offer_id not in last:last[o.offer_id]=o
    if o.price is not None and (o.currency or "").strip() and o.offer_id not in latest_price:latest_price[o.offer_id]=o
    if o.delivery_days is not None or o.search_delivery_days is not None:ever_numeric.add(o.offer_id)
placed=OfferFamilyPlacement.objects.filter(offer_id__in=ids).values("product_family__slug").annotate(total=Count("offer_id",distinct=True))
result={"time":now.isoformat(),"public_total":len(offers),"public_price_not_fresh_24h":sum((i not in latest_price or latest_price[i].observed_at < now-timedelta(hours=24)) for i in ids),"public_without_any_numeric_delivery":sum(i not in ever_numeric for i in ids),"public_with_some_numeric_delivery":sum(i in ever_numeric for i in ids),"eligible_by_family_placements":{x["product_family__slug"]:x["total"] for x in placed},"latest_observations_older_than_24h":sum(i not in last or last[i].observed_at < now-timedelta(hours=24) for i in ids)}
print("DEEP_CATALOG_JSON="+json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True))
